{{Quote|A tender cut of pork imported directly from Gamorr, prepared with a tigmary dry rub and pan-fried to perfection. Served smothered in rich snoruuk gravy.|Dex's Diner on its Gamorrean pork chop|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Gamorrean pork chop''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] used [[pork]] imported<ref name="Menu" /> from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Consisting of a pan fried cut of pork prepared with a [[Tigmary/Legends|tigmary dry rub]], the dish was served with [[snoruuk gravy]].<ref name="Menu" /> At some point no later than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the diner sold the dish for 9.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gamorrean pork chop was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
